newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Carson Pirie Scott estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Carson Pirie Scott estimates raised.

text.p: -- Dillon Read & Co Inc said Monday it raised its estimate for Carson Pirie Scott & Co's 1997 earnings to $2.56 a share from $2.49 and its estimate for 1998 earnings to $2.80 a share from $2.76.
-- The move follows Monday's report of strong fourth-quarter earnings of $1.73 a share, compared to $1.61 a year earlier and a consensus estimate of $1.76, Dillon Read said.
-- Dillon Read said the improvement can be attributed to higher gross margins and lower-than-expected operating expenses.
-- Milwaukee-based Carson is a department store chain operator.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/2 Monday at 27-3/4.
